{{Quote|On Cholganna, the dinner bell is always ringing somewhere.|Joma Dehn comments on Cholganna|<ref name="BTR">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref>}}
'''Joma Dehn''' was an individual who became a veteran [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] of members of the [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Dehn hunted the animals on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]] at some [[Time/Legends|time]] during or prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Joma Dehn was first mentioned in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', a [[2013]] adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. The character's name and occupation, with no further context, is given as the source of a quote describing Cholganna.<ref name="BTR" />
